properties.name: Canopy by Hilton Reykjavik City Centre
properties.desc: Night 1 & last night — Reykjavík City Centre.

properties.name: Hotel Rangá, an SLH Hotel
properties.desc: Night 2 & 3 (2 nights) — SLH hotel near Hella. Noted for its restaurant + whisky selection (Wolfgang's a whisky fan). Northern-lights wake-up service in season.

properties.name: Hótel Kría
properties.desc: Night 4 — Vík.

properties.name: Fosshotel Glacier Lagoon
properties.desc: Night 5 — ~10 min from the Jökulsárlón zodiac dock.

properties.name: Aldan Hotel & Restaurant
properties.desc: Night 6 — Seyðisfjörður.

properties.name: Vogafjós Farm Resort
properties.desc: Night 7 — lakeside farm stay with its own cowshed restaurant.

properties.name: Sel-Hotel Myvatn
properties.desc: Alternative Day 7–8 lodge (modern lakefront hotel).

properties.name: Hótel Búðir
properties.desc: Night 9 — the black-church splurge stay, on the lava field.

properties.name: D1-Bridge Between Continents
properties.desc: Walk across the rift between the North-American & Eurasian plates.

properties.name: D1-Sky Lagoon
properties.desc: Geothermal spa ritual, ocean-view infinity edge. Book a slot; great at sunset.

properties.name: D1-Laugavegur
properties.desc: Reykjavík's main shopping street.

properties.name: D1-Skólavörðustígur Rainbow Street
properties.desc: The rainbow-painted street leading up to Hallgrímskirkja.

properties.name: D1-Harpa Concert Hall and Conference Centre
properties.desc: Glass concert hall on the old harbour.

properties.name: D1-Hallgrimskirkja
properties.desc: Iconic church; the tower has the best city view.

properties.name: D1-Harbor in Reykjavik
properties.desc: Old harbour — whale-watching boats and seafood restaurants.

properties.name: D1-The Settlement Exhibition
properties.desc: Underground museum built around a real Viking longhouse ruin.

properties.name: Skál!
properties.desc: New-Nordic small plates (Njálsgata).

properties.name: Bæjarins Beztu Pylsur
properties.desc: Reykjavík's famous hot-dog stand.

properties.name: Seabaron
properties.desc: Harbour seafood — the lobster soup.

properties.name: Lava Show
properties.desc: Live molten-lava show — book a showtime.

properties.name: Reykjavík Maritime Museum
properties.desc: Harbour museum on Iceland's seafaring history.

properties.name: Tjörnin
properties.desc: The city pond, next to City Hall.

properties.name: Perlan
properties.desc: Museum + rotating glass-dome observation deck.

properties.name: Kolaportið Market
properties.desc: Weekend flea & food market (Sat–Sun).

properties.name: Katla Ice Cave
properties.desc: EVENING tour after Hótel Kría check-in (Vík). Year-round ice cave under Kötlujökull, super-jeep, ~3 h. Book ahead.
properties.reserve: Guided tour only — book in advance

properties.name: D2-1-Thingvellir National Park
properties.desc: Rift valley & site of the world's oldest parliament — walk between the tectonic plates.

properties.name: D2-3-Gullfoss Falls
properties.desc: The 'Golden Falls' — a two-tier 32 m cascade.

properties.name: D2-6-Kerið Crater
properties.desc: Volcanic crater lake with red-rhyolite walls.

properties.name: D2-5-Secret Lagoon (optional)
properties.desc: Iceland's oldest natural pool — optional stop, book ahead.

properties.name: Parking Area at Basecamp
properties.desc: Landmannalaugar base camp / trailhead; lunch spot.

properties.name: D2-Selvoss-optional
properties.desc: Optional town stop — the plan goes straight to Hella instead.

properties.name: D2-4-Friðheimar
properties.desc: Greenhouse tomato-farm lunch (kitchen 11:30–16:00). Book ahead.

properties.name: Landmannalaugar Bathing Place
properties.desc: Natural hot river at the camp — soak after the hike.

properties.name: Seljalandsfoss
properties.desc: Walk BEHIND the falls — bring a rain shell. ~45 min.

properties.name: Skógafoss
properties.desc: The big 60 m curtain — climb the stairs for the top view. ~45 min.

properties.name: Dyrhólaey
properties.desc: Arch headland viewpoint; puffins in summer. ~30 min.

properties.name: Reynisfjara Beach
properties.desc: Black sand + basalt columns. ⚠️ Stay well back — deadly sneaker waves. ~45 min.

properties.name: Skógar Museum
properties.desc: Folk & transport museum right at Skógafoss. ~1–1.5 h (optional). (OPTIONAL — skip if the day runs long)

properties.name: Svartifoss Trail
properties.desc: Basalt-column 'Black Falls' — ~1.5–2 h round trip from the Skaftafell visitor centre. Base for the guided glacier hike.

properties.name: Jökulsárlón
properties.desc: Glacier lagoon — do the ZODIAC (1:15, reaches the glacier) in the evening after checking in. Book via icelagoon.is or icelagoon.com.
properties.reserve: EVENING zodiac after Fosshotel check-in — book ahead (May–Oct)

properties.name: Diamond Beach
properties.desc: Icebergs washed ashore on black sand, next to Jökulsárlón. ~30 min.

properties.name: Viking Cafe & Guesthouse
properties.desc: Stokksnes gate & café — pay the ~900 ISK entry here to reach the Vestrahorn dunes. Stop on Day 6, NOT an overnight.

properties.name: Vestrahorn Mountain
properties.desc: Sunrise shot on the Stokksnes dunes (1.2 km from Viking Café). ~1–1.5 h.

properties.name: Djúpivogur
properties.desc: Quiet East Fjords fishing village — coffee/fuel stop. ~30 min.

properties.name: Eggin í Gleðivík
properties.desc: The 34 egg sculptures on the harbour — quick photo stop. ~15 min.

properties.name: Petra's Stone Collection
properties.desc: Private mineral collection in Stöðvarfjörður. ~1–1.5 h.

properties.name: Dettifoss (West Side)
properties.desc: Europe's most powerful waterfall — the west-bank viewpoint (Route 862, paved). ~45 min.

properties.name: Earth Lagoon Mývatn
properties.desc: Geothermal spa by Lake Mývatn. High season 10:00–22:00 — soak late after the drive.

properties.name: Hverir
properties.desc: Boiling mud pots & fumaroles at Námafjall. ~30 min (stay on the path — it's scalding).

properties.name: Lava field of Dimmuborgir
properties.desc: 'Dark castles' lava formations; walking loops. ~45 min.

properties.name: Grjótagjá
properties.desc: Lava cave with a geothermal pool (bathing now banned). ~15 min.

properties.name: Krafla
properties.desc: Víti explosion crater + geothermal power station. ~30 min.

properties.name: Skútustadagrig pseudo craters
properties.desc: Lakeside pseudo-craters; quick walk. ~20 min.

properties.name: Fjaðrárgljúfur
properties.desc: Dramatic 100 m-deep canyon with a rim walk. ~45 min.

properties.name: Gljúfrabúi
properties.desc: Hidden waterfall in a slot canyon, 2 min from Seljalandsfoss. ~20 min.

properties.name: Solheimajökull Glacier Tongue
properties.desc: Walk out to the glacier tongue (ice-hike tours start here). ~30–45 min. (OPTIONAL — skip if the day runs long)

properties.name: Kirkjufell
properties.desc: The arrow-shaped mountain (most-photographed in Iceland) + Kirkjufellsfoss falls. ~30–45 min.

properties.name: Arnarstapi
properties.desc: Coastal cliffs + the Gatklettur sea arch; lovely cliff walk. ~1 h.

properties.name: Goðafoss Waterfall
properties.desc: 'Waterfall of the Gods' — wide horseshoe falls right off Route 1. ~30–45 min.

properties.name: Akureyri
properties.desc: North Iceland's capital — stop for Brynja ice cream + lunch. ~1 h.

properties.name: Húsavík Harbor
properties.desc: Whale-watching capital — oak-boat tours ~3 h. Book ahead.

properties.name: Dritvik Djúpalónssandur
properties.desc: Black-pebble beach with the four 'lifting stones' + shipwreck remains. ~30–45 min.

properties.name: Búðakirkja
properties.desc: The famous BLACK CHURCH on the Snæfellsnes lava field — iconic photo. ~20 min.

properties.name: Fjallsárlón
properties.desc: Quieter glacier lagoon with a close-up iceberg view. ~45 min (optional).

properties.name: The Blue Church
properties.desc: Bláa kirkjan — Seyðisfjörður's blue church. ~30 min.

properties.name: Gljúfrastofa - Ásbyrgi Visitor Centre
properties.desc: Ásbyrgi horseshoe canyon — dramatic cliffs + easy walks; visitor centre. ~1 h.

properties.name: D2-2-Strokkur Geyser
properties.desc: Erupts every ~8 minutes, 20–30 m high.

properties.name: D2-Dinner
properties.desc: Dinner near Hella / Hótel Rangá.

properties.name: Day 1 driving route
properties.desc: KEF → Reykjavík via the Reykjanes rift.

properties.name: Day 2 driving route
properties.desc: Reykjavík → Golden Circle → Hella (Rangá).

properties.name: Day 3 — guided tour route (not self-drive)
properties.hours: ~67 mi · ~1.9 h (tour driving — you're a passenger)
properties.desc: Midgard → Landmannalaugar over the F-roads, driven by the guide. YOUR own drive on Day 3 is just Rangá ↔ Midgard (~7 min each way).

properties.name: Midgard Base Camp — tour departure
properties.reserve: Book: Landmannalaugar Highlands Day Tour — Midgard Adventure · +354 578 3370
properties.desc: Where the super-jeep tour departs. Park & meet your guide.

properties.name: Day 4 driving route
properties.desc: Rangá → waterfalls → glacier → Katla Ice Cave → Dyrhólaey → Reynisfjara → Vík.

properties.name: Day 5 driving route
properties.desc: Vík → Fjaðrárgljúfur → Skaftafell → Fjallsárlón → Jökulsárlón (zodiac) → Diamond Beach → Fosshotel (boat-tour area).

properties.name: Day 6 driving route
properties.desc: Fosshotel → Stokksnes/Vestrahorn → Djúpivogur → Petra's Stones → Seyðisfjörður.

properties.name: Day 7 driving route
properties.desc: Seyðisfjörður → Dettifoss → Ásbyrgi → Lake Mývatn.

properties.name: Day 8 driving route
properties.desc: Mývatn loop + Húsavík (Hverir, Krafla, Dimmuborgir, Grjótagjá, whale watching).

properties.name: Day 9 driving route
properties.desc: Mývatn → Goðafoss → Akureyri → Snæfellsnes (Búðir).

properties.name: Day 10 driving route
properties.desc: Snæfellsnes loop (Arnarstapi, Djúpalónssandur, Kirkjufell) → Reykjavík.

properties.name: Höfn (overnight)
properties.desc: Alternative Day 5 town (~1 h east of the lagoon) — not used.
